newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent due 5 cents up, gas oil up $1.25-$1.50.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent due 5 cents up, gas oil up $1.25-$1.50.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures were called to open 5-7 cents higher on Thursday.
IPE August gas oil was anticpated to open $1.25-$1.50 higher.
But dealers remained cautious ahead of U.S. product expiries on Thursday.
"I would expect to see a hesitation and a retracement after the expiry of the front month U.S. products," one broker said. "The market will be keeping a close eye on U.S. gasoline."
September Brent closed 17 cents higher on Wednesday at $18.97 a barrel, just three cents off the day's 8-week $19 high.
August gas oil closed $3.25 up on Wednedsay at $171 a tonne.

Gas oil and crude on Wednesday advanced on the back of U.S. gasoline, which rallied srongly after U.S. Department of Energy and American Petroleum Insitute stock data showed lower than expected gasoline stocks.
Production interruptions and increased demand during the busy summer driving season in the U.S. also helped to boost gasoline.
Front-month unleaded gasoline and heating oil contracts expire on Thursday.
